general.description: General research and multi-step execution that needs no architectural judgment — use for routine investigation, verification, and parallelizable units of work.

council.prompt: Read docs/council_voices.yaml completely before deliberating and hold the five voices (Mountain, River, Mycelium, Sensory, Future) as it prescribes — the way of council: speak from the heart, listen from the heart, be spontaneous, be lean of expression. The light form holds each text once; the full circle sits only for architecture.

grind-flash.description: Routine source-port work that needs bash+edit but no judgment: API reachability verification (curl), catalog harvesting, mechanical recheck batches, --probe review of obvious cases. No Force-Gate decisions.

grind-pro.description: Judgment source-port work: Force-Gate litmus classification, parser-gap research, novel source curation, kraft-kanal research. Not for mechanical harvest/verify/recheck.
